summary: Clear the fog, face the wild, and guide your settlers through uncharted lands!
description:
Townsfolk – Build. Explore. Survive.

Lead a group of settlers into the unknown and build a thriving colony in an uncharted land filled with mystery and danger. Manage scarce resources, make tough choices, and shape your settlement’s fate. Will your town prosper, or will it fall to the challenges of the frontier?

Forge Your Legacy:
Build & Expand – Carefully manage Food, Gold, Faith, and Production to grow your village and keep settlers alive.
Explore the Unknown – Clear the fog to uncover hidden treasures, lurking dangers, and new opportunities.
Adapt to Challenges – Face unpredictable disasters, wild animals, and difficult moral dilemmas that test your leadership.
Appease the King – The Crown demands tribute—fail to deliver, and your settlement may pay the price.

Features:
Roguelite Campaign – Each playthrough presents new challenges and unique opportunities.
Skirmish Mode – Standalone scenarios to test your strategy and survival skills.
Puzzle Challenges – Engage in strategic puzzles that push your problem-solving abilities.

Pixel Art Beauty – A handcrafted world brought to life with atmospheric music and detailed visuals.

Minimalist Strategy, Deep Gameplay – Simple to learn, but mastering survival is another challenge.

Create a thriving settlement and make your King—and kingdom—proud. Download TownsFolk today.

Play for Free – Upgrade Anytime
TownsFolk lets you jump in for free! Enjoy the How to Play missions, test your skills in Puzzle Missions, and try out Skirmish Mode with a fixed setup.

Want more? A one-time in-app purchase unlocks the full Campaign and lets you customize settings in Skirmish Mode for endless replayability.
